steps.line: kris sits in his car in the hotel lot. exhausted. he dials violets number from the 5 dollar bill
goes to voicemail, he hangs up when he hears her voice
he realizes she really did give him her number lol. texts her: is this a beautiful woman with purple hair who ruins hawaiian pizza with black olives?
puts the phone down. ok i did my part now i wait
turns on some music from his phone and sits back resting his eyes. now i wait
takes a hit off his weed vape
